Even after Cameron saved himself with the POV, Red was not initially the target, as Jared was focused on evicting [[Jag Bains]]. However, after Red reconciled with Cameron, [[The Fields]] alliance decided to target him instead to weaken Cameron. Unable to recover, Red was evicted in an 8-2 vote, placing 12th.
